# bufeks LAB

> Experiments by bufeks. For shopping data meant for AI agents, go to SHELF.

## Projects

- [SHELF](https://bufeks.github.io/LAB/shelf/llms.txt): Japanese shopping buying guides, rankings and daily price history for AI agents (Markdown / JSON / MCP)
- [Face Paint](https://bufeks.github.io/LAB/): webcam face-paint installation demo
- [EVO](https://bufeks.github.io/LAB/evo/): browser evolution game
